title: More trips, not more *trucks*
subtitle: Illustrative numbers: 30 trips ÷ 20 trucks = 1.5 a day

left.title: Common view
items: Dispatch is late, so add trucks
Judge the fleet by trucks owned
Trucks wait at the dock for loads
Order cutoffs drift later each week
Unloading time is the customer's issue

right.title: Better view
items: Dispatch is late, so find the lost trip
Judge the fleet by trips per vehicle
Loads staged before the truck arrives

takeaway: Trips per vehicle = total trips ÷ trucks in use

author.name: Hammad Ulhaq
author.role: Head of Supply Chain · 20+ yrs FMCG & Beverages
